scope: Local server environment and owner MFA login regression
root_cause: Docker artisan serve filtered inherited environment; its HTTP child fell back to .env SQLite while CLI checks used PostgreSQL.
fix: Explicit --no-reload for Docker, direct local and Playwright servers; no authentication-policy changes.

runtime_regression.command: docker compose exec -T -e APP_ENV=testing -e DB_DATABASE=webmail_auth_e2e app php scripts/verify-auth-runtime.php
runtime_regression.before_fix: Failed: password request did not reach MFA for the PostgreSQL-only fixture.
runtime_regression.after_fix: Passed: password, MFA, fresh-request admin access, logout revocation.

server_postgresql.command: docker compose exec -T -e APP_ENV=testing -e DB_DATABASE=webmail_test app php artisan test
